evidence.quote: No fees during the introductory phase (except for language classes beyond B1)
Please send a letter of motivation and your CV (each max. two pages) to intotechnology@hs-hannover.de.

notes: Le 'semester contribution' (environ 400 EUR/semestre, payé une fois étudiant à temps plein) n'est pas des frais de scolarité et il existe des périodes d'application différentes pour les candidats internationaux; les frais d'études sont nuls pendant la phase d'introduction. Les dates limites d'application: 'This programme has no deadline listed.' Therefore no intakes fact is stated. Evidence for tuition: 'No fees during the introductory phase (except for language classes beyond B1)'.

note.fr: Fournissez les résultats du 'fast check' de votre qualification d'accès aux études supérieures via l'outil uni-assist.
note.en: Provide the results of the fast check of your university entrance qualification for Germany via the uni-assist tool.

evidence.quote: Please also provide the results of the fast check of your university entrance qualification for Germany (use the uni-assist tool https://www.uni-assist.de/en/tools/check-university-admission) and details about your German-language knowledge (e.g., German-language certificates).
